translations.web: Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid waste.
translations.bsb: Our holy and beautiful temple, where our fathers praised You, has been burned with fire, and all that was dear to us lies in ruins.
translations.kjv: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.
